summary: The current advice is to wait before investing the 10,000 rupees in India and to buy JPMorgan Chase shares with the 100 dollars in the US. Analysts are discussing Deepak Fertilizers' recent profit jump and past price drops, noting the stock is still below its highest level. They also note that the Indian budget only allows buying whole shares of cheaper companies like Tata Motors or Exide, while US fractional shares allow owning pieces of expensive stocks like Tesla.
